name: What should I consider when choosing a location for a freestanding tub?
description: Consider clear space for access and cleaning, and proximity to existing plumbing to simplify installation.

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing a location for a freestanding tub?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a location, consider both aesthetic appeal and practical factors. Ensure there is enough clear space around the tub for comfortable access, cleaning, and safety. Proximity to existing plumbing lines can significantly reduce installation complexity and cost. Our team can advise on optimal placement within your bathroom, balancing design goals with structural and plumbing feasibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider clear space for access and cleaning, and proximity to existing plumbing to simplify installation.
